the development of an interface that is adaptive to the cognitive profile of each user, which is capable of recommending objects of learning from repositories, local and remote, in real time.

developing and testing a new approach to the design and implementation of personalized interfaces for e-learning systems, which can adapt the presentation and visualization of learning objects according to the preferences of students.
